outputs.explanation: Spatial expression panel is a heatmap overlay on tissue (spatial transcriptomics), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of micrographs (H&E and RNAscope fluorescence images), not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
Panel C is a scatter plot showing median with 95% CI, and all individual patient data points (dots) are displayed for both LUAD and LUSC groups.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each of the four groups.
